name: MirrorLagCritical - Warning
description: Mirror lag exceeds warn threshold for critical tier (30s). Monitor for further degradation.
search: index=kafka sourcetype=confluent_cloud:metrics metric_name="cluster_link_mirror_topic_offset_lag" kafka_id="{{CLUSTER_ID}}" | stats latest(metric_value) as lag_seconds by topic | where lag_seconds > 30 AND lag_seconds <= 60

name: MirrorLagCritical - Alert

name: ConnectTaskFailed
description: One or more Kafka Connect connector tasks are in FAILED state. Check Connect logs and restart if appropriate.
search: index=kafka sourcetype=kafka:connect kafka_id="{{CLUSTER_ID}}" connector_state="FAILED" | stats count by connector_name | where count >= 1

name: ConnectTaskRestartLoop
description: A Kafka Connect task has restarted 3 or more times in the last 15 minutes. Investigate root cause to prevent repeated failures.
search: index=kafka sourcetype=kafka:connect kafka_id="{{CLUSTER_ID}}" event_type="task_restart" | stats count as restart_count by connector_name | where restart_count >= 3

name: UnderReplicatedPartitions
description: Under-replicated partitions detected for more than 5 minutes. This indicates broker health issues or network problems. Investigate immediately.
search: index=kafka sourcetype=confluent_cloud:metrics metric_name="under_replicated_partitions" kafka_id="{{CLUSTER_ID}}" | stats latest(metric_value) as under_replicated | where under_replicated > 0
